page_title: MAI 0-1 WER | Mainz v Werder Bremen 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Benjamin Brand has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
90+5' Werder Bremen are ruled offside.
90+3' Here's the change. Felix Agu leaves the pitch and Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) comes on as a substitute.
90+3' David Mamutovic (Mainz) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
88' That's a clear yellow card. Anthony Caci (Mainz) goes into the book.
87' Marco Richter (Mainz) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
86' The substitution has been made. Christian Gross (Werder Bremen) has replaced Jens Stage.
85' It's time for a substitution. David Mamutovic (Mainz) comes on in place of Jessic Ngankam.
85' Here is a change. Phillipp Mwene is going off and Jan Siewert gives the last tactical orders to Dominik Kohr (Mainz).
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nadiem Amiri as he is replaced by Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz).
82' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar.
82' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.
79' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
79' The attendance is 30000.
78' Anthony Caci (Mainz) passes the ball and slows down the tempo so his team can continue with their combination play.
75' Anthony Caci (Mainz) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
75' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
74' Mainz have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
74' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) tackles a bit over-zealously and Benjamin Brand blows for a foul.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tom Krauss trots off the pitch and is replaced by Marco Richter (Mainz).
69' Substitution. Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) replaces Romano Schmid.
69' Ole Werner decides to make a substitution. Justin Njinmah will be replaced by Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen).
69' That will be all from Marvin Ducksch who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen).
67' What was Tom Krauss (Mainz) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
67' What a miss! The corner finds Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the right post.
67' The corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is intercepted by the defence.
67' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is about to take a corner kick.
67' The corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is hurriedly cleared. Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) comes onto the pitch for Jonathan Burkardt.
62' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) will take a corner kick.
61' Jessic Ngankam (Mainz) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Michael Zetterer is alert and denies him with a nice save.
58' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) works the corner short.
57' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Mainz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
53' Jessic Ngankam (Mainz) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
50' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
46' Jessic Ngankam (Mainz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Benjamin Brand has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner with a short pass.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
44' It seemed like Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
42' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the left post. Terrific solo effort, though.
41' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) swings in a cross from the corner, but Michael Zetterer reads it well and gathers the ball.
40' 58:42 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
38' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Benjamin Brand didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' The resulting corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is cleared.
31' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Jessic Ngankam (Mainz) offside.
28' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) makes a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
27' The ball is cleared after Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

25' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
24' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) unleashes a beautiful mid-range volley to the bottom left corner, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains the same.
23' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) tries to find Marvin Ducksch, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
20' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
19' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
17' Tom Krauss (Mainz) fires a brilliant shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rattles the right post! It could have been a superb goal.
16' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
16' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range. Mainz force a corner. They send men into the box.
15' Mainz have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.

15' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Benjamin Brand blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
11' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen), whose header floated just over the bar.
10' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
8' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
7' The Mainz players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
5' A crossfield pass from Robin Zentner (Mainz) fails to find any of his teammates.
2' 0 - 1 Goal! Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:1.
1' The first half has just begun.
Mainz will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Benjamin Brand.
